name: Enigma
description: A quantum-ready, AI-native compute currency. ENIG rewards verifiable proof-of-work capacity and prices settlement by live compute supply vs demand.
curve: secp256k1 (v1; post-quantum migration path via header version 2)
address_format: Base58Check (version byte 0x00, identical to Bitcoin P2PKH)

compute_market.description: Live demand/supply ratio from mempool pressure and network hashrate
